authorization.deliverable: Deep research and finite options in chat; user chooses before implementation.

scope.goal: Increase eventual UNO sales through launch interest, relevant email updates and requested sales conversations.
scope.user_variant: Floating control at the right while scrolling opens name, phone and email form; submit once and close. Requiredness was not specified by user.
scope.current_site: English-only premium product story. Three sales CTA launch notices and separate Explore the Set details notice. Existing fixed 48px back-to-top uses bottom-right safe area.
scope.date_source: Explicit earlier user confirmation, not externally verified product availability.
scope.not_a_current_capability: No verified lead database, email workflow, CRM or actual preorder checkout.

evidence_policy.distinction: UX research, official design guidance, vendor guidance, analytics definitions and legal/channel rules support different kinds of claims. None proves a Ramsider conversion uplift.

sources.title: Phone Number UX: Always Explain Why the Phone Field Is Required
sources.observed: Key takeaways and dated article; lines114-127.
sources.supports: Unexplained required phone fields can cause concern, false entries or abandonment; explain purpose, make optional where possible or remove.
sources.limits: Checkout evidence, not a controlled lead-capture test. The reported14% reluctance is not predicted Ramsider abandonment or achievable uplift.
sources.application: Phone is required only for a chosen callback; tell people why it is collected.

sources.title: Popups: 10 Problematic Trends and Alternatives
sources.type: Primary usability study plus expert synthesis
sources.supports: Offer context and value before asking for contact; premature and repeated overlays interrupt user tasks.
sources.limits: Qualitative and older guidance, not a numerical sales experiment or ban on all user-initiated dialogs.
sources.application: Open on explicit action; no forced on-load modal or repeated timer prompts.

sources.title: Interstitials and dialogs
sources.observed: Small banner guidance lines136-144 and dated footer166.
sources.supports: Small nonblocking banners preserve content access better than full-page promotional interstitials.
sources.limits: Does not establish that a user-requested accessible form modal harms SEO; no promised ranking or conversion change.
sources.application: Compact launcher while browsing, deliberate open.

sources.title: Question pages
sources.observed: Only ask what is needed and mark optional fields, lines165-182.
sources.supports: Have a purpose for every field and explain optional information.
sources.limits: Not an ecommerce A/B result; does not establish an optimal field count for UNO.
sources.application: Email for updates; phone for callback; optional name unless operationally needed.

sources.title: Coming Soon Page Examples & Templates (2026)
sources.observed: Waitlist/product-drop use cases131-162; short description, date and email187; date102.
sources.supports: Prelaunch interest capture can create a reachable audience for subsequent launch communication.
sources.limits: Vendor guidance, not proof that waitlists or a particular widget increase RAMSIDER sales. Do not transfer stock scarcity, early access or discount claims from examples.
sources.application: Launch list with confirmed launch date and concrete information benefits; no invented allocation priority.

sources.title: Pre-orders
sources.supports: A genuine preorder may take full, partial or no upfront payment.
sources.limits: Shopify-specific platform requirements are not a Ramsider architecture recommendation or universal law.
sources.application: Contact capture is launch interest. A real preorder requires agreed order terms and order handling; absence of payment alone does not distinguish it.

sources.title: Methodology behind the Conversion Benchmark Report
sources.supports: Benchmarks depend on population, conversion definition and exclusions.
sources.limits: Pages with no conversions or fewer than50visitors are excluded. Cannot assign a universal submit-rate target or expected sales uplift to RAMSIDER.
sources.application: Establish own funnel by traffic, device and intent; do not optimize to a generic internet conversion number.

sources.title: Understanding sign-up form analytics
sources.supports: A multistep form can count a submit at its first email/phone step; teaser-only views are excluded from form views.
sources.limits: Platform reporting definitions; submit is not necessarily full form completion, unique person, permission, qualification or sale.
sources.application: Track launcher exposure/open, full valid unique lead and selected intent explicitly.

sources.title: Understanding revenue metrics for sign-up forms
sources.supports: Forms can be linked to orders and revenue using configured attribution.
sources.limits: Lookback-associated revenue does not demonstrate incremental causation; platform choice remains open.
sources.application: Primary postlaunch outcome is paid orders/revenue per eligible visitor; track lead-to-order by cohort. Randomized comparison if sufficient traffic.

sources.title: How do we comply with the PECR electronic mail marketing rules?
sources.observed: Solicited/unsolicited distinctions59-67; affirmative specific consent74-111; service number versus promotional use113-124.
sources.supports: Marketing purpose/channel should be clear; no preticked consent; keep evidence and allow withdrawal. A service/callback number does not silently authorize unrelated marketing.
sources.limits: UK-specific, not a worldwide legal conclusion. A clearly described newsletter action may itself express consent; a checkbox is not universally mandatory. Need target-market/category review before launch of collection or sending.
sources.application: Explicit update subscription versus explicit callback request. Optional unticked newsletter opt-in on callback route; purpose/time/text-version records and unsubscribe.

sources.title: Campaign rejected: tobacco or vape content detected (30958)
sources.supports: Tobacco/vape promotion and related devices/accessories face prohibition on this US messaging route.
sources.limits: Specific A2P10DLC restriction, not a blanket ban on phone calls, emails or all countries; no legal product classification inferred.
sources.application: Do not promise automatic SMS/WhatsApp campaigns from phone collection; verify actual category/geography/provider eligibility.

sources.title: Understanding SMS and MMS prohibited content
sources.supports: Tobacco-related SMS eligibility varies with geography, account, sending number and age-gating rules.
sources.limits: Not an endorsement of Klaviyo for RAMSIDER, and not a universal prohibition. Avoid incompatible channel before approved.
sources.application: Provider selection follows category and target-market approval; email also needs provider review independently.

sources.title: Making retries safe with idempotent APIs
sources.author: Malcolm Featonby
sources.observed: Unique caller token and atomic mutation241-256; changed intent468-471.
sources.supports: Reuse request identifier on retry and atomically record mutation to prevent duplicate side effects; semantically equivalent success.
sources.limits: Retry idempotency is not human identity or permanent one-per-person enforcement; external notifications need their own delivery/deduplication controls.
sources.application: Server idempotency, contact+campaign+intent dedupe, durable receipt and deduplicated follow-up workflow.

sources.title: Confirmation pages
sources.supports: Confirm success and explain what happens next.
sources.limits: Adapt to a small sales form; does not require a full government-style page, reference ID or PDF.
sources.application: Server-confirmed success state with Done, not silent close or clearing input on failure.

sources.title: User Notification
sources.observed: After-submit feedback and first-error focus195-200; related WCAG324-329.
sources.supports: Clear success/error feedback and accessible error handling.
sources.limits: Following one tutorial alone does not establish WCAG compliance.
sources.application: Visible labels, associated error messages, focus handling, preserved values, explicit success.

options.name: Original floating three-field form
options.placement: Right-side floating icon, user opens it.
options.fields: Name, phone, email visible together. User did not specify requiredness; making all three mandatory is a separate decision.
options.benefit: All contact modes immediately available; easy operational routing if purpose is explicit.
options.tradeoff: Unlabelled icon may be overlooked. Mandatory phone may deter update-only visitors. Without intent labels, team cannot infer callback versus subscription.

options.name: Email-first launch list
options.placement: Current sales CTA dialogs and a labelled launcher.
options.fields: Email required; optional name. Offer callback separately after acknowledged success.
options.benefit: Least input for update-only interest and a clear promise.
options.tradeoff: May collect more low-intent contacts; email alone does not indicate readiness for a sales conversation.

options.name: Launch list plus callback choice — recommended
options.placement: Shared form from current sales CTA plus compact labelled right-side launcher; user opens it.
options.fields: Default Get Launch Updates: email required, name optional. Alternative Request a Call: phone with country code required, name optional; optional unchecked email-updates control reveals email only when selected.
options.benefit: Captures low-friction email interest while allowing higher-intent conversations; each contact has a clear purpose.
options.tradeoff: One additional route choice and real sales follow-up ownership needed; no proven superiority before RAMSIDER test.

options.name: In-page form without floating launcher
options.placement: Compact block near ordering/final section, with links from sales CTA.
options.benefit: No persistent overlay over artwork; full context for offer.
options.tradeoff: May be missed by visitors who never reach it; new block must fit approved long-page composition.

recommendation.rationale: Balance permission to nurture launch interest with deliberate callback intent; existing sales actions already express interest and should also feed the shared form.

placement.desktop: Small right-side pill with label UNO Launch; not a misleading live-chat bubble.
placement.mobile: Compact labelled control within safe area, proposed to appear once the hero CTA is out of view. Position and threshold are test hypotheses.
integration: Reserve Now and both Create Your UNO retain launch notice and offer Join the Launch List / Request a Call.
Explore the Set retains details/date message with Notify Me When Details Are Available action; submit purpose remains explicit.
Hospitality Solutions link remains a B2B destination; not forced into consumer signup.
suppression: No automatic modal on load/timer/exit intent.
Hide launcher in fullscreen media, galleries, open menus/forms.
Avoid existing bottom-right back-to-top collision; preserve underlying content and keyboard-safe scrolling.
After acknowledged success, suppress repeated invitation in that browser but allow status and preference/contact changes.

copy.update_body: Discover the full UNO collection, get pre-order news, and receive launch updates by email. Worldwide sales begin November 20, 2026.
copy.update_permission: By joining, you agree to receive RAMSIDER UNO launch news, product updates, and offers by email. Unsubscribe at any time.
copy.call_body: Speak with our team about UNO models, pricing, and purchase options.
copy.call_helper: We’ll use your number to respond to your request.
copy.call_email_opt_in: Email me RAMSIDER UNO launch news, product updates, and offers.
copy.opt_in_state: Unchecked and optional; email is required only if this separate update subscription is selected. No SMS or WhatsApp permission inferred.
copy.call_email_without_opt_in: Do not collect email on the callback route unless the optional email-update subscription is selected, or a separately explained written-reply purpose is requested.
copy.confirmation: Confirmed server receipt → show what was received and next step → Done closes form. If email confirmation is required, say Check Your Email rather than falsely confirming subscription.
not_promised: Callback time until staffed SLA agreed
copy.call_optional_email: Unchecked optional email-updates control reveals Email (required only if subscription selected). No email field without an explicit purpose.

recommendation.offer: Information is the currently supportable value. A real launch incentive could strengthen the proposition, but owner must approve benefit, eligibility, dates and commercial margin before it appears. No fake scarcity or made-up crossed-out price.

once_contract.interpretation: One existing contact record per campaign/intent, safe retries, no duplicate callback task or subscription side effect; not an irrevocable one-use-per-human ban.
once_contract.browser: Disable pending submit; after server acknowledgement retain a non-PII receipt/status flag. Local storage is convenience, not enforcement.
once_contract.backend: Stable idempotency key per attempt reused after timeout; atomic durable record/upsert with unique normalized contact+campaign+intent key. Server normalizes conservatively; do not strip email plus aliases/dots indiscriminately. Phone uses country code.
once_contract.identity_and_consent: Verification policy must be chosen. Unverified input must not overwrite verified preferences or resubscribe an opted-out contact. Generic duplicate acknowledgement avoids disclosing whether an arbitrary email/phone is registered; preference changes require verified authority.
once_contract.notifications: Queue after durable receipt; deduplicate jobs and use provider idempotency when supported. Do not promise mathematically exactly-once delivery across arbitrary third-party providers.
once_contract.errors: Keep values and show retryable error if not accepted. Retry must not create another record/task.
once_contract.abuse: Server validation/rate limits and proportional bot protection; no duplicate filtering solely by IP.
once_contract.limits: Cross-device anonymity, cleared storage, shared contacts and alternate addresses mean exactly one submission per person globally cannot be guaranteed without identity. Users must be able to correct contact or change intent/consent.

sales_operations.destination: Persistent lead storage plus named owner/CRM routing, selected after current account/access/country constraints are known; mailbox notification alone is not the authoritative record.
sales_operations.routing: Email marketing audience and callback queue remain separate purposes. Optional model/personal-vs-business profiling only after first success or in conversation.
sales_operations.followup: Immediate acknowledgement/confirmation as appropriate; relevant product reveal and approved launch/offer messages to subscribed email cohort; human callback on explicit request. Frequency and callback SLA must match actual capacity.
prerequisites_before_collection: Initial target markets and category/age/contact requirements
Callback handling capacity and time expectation
Any real presale incentive and actual preorder terms if desired
sales_operations.not_done: No lead capture, outbound email, SMS, WhatsApp, automation or order processing implemented.

measurement.prelaunch: Unique valid/confirmed update subscriptions and qualified callback requests per eligible visitor, split by intent/device/traffic; these are sales proxies.
measurement.postlaunch: Paid orders and net revenue per eligible visitor; lead-to-order by source/intent/cohort and handling cost. Define cancellations/refunds and attribution window.
funnel: Launcher exposure or original CTA click
measurement.experiments: Keep offer constant while testing placement or fields separately; stable randomized assignment and predefined outcome, horizon and sufficient sample. No universal required conversion percentage. Insufficient traffic → directional results, not declared statistical winner.
measurement.attribution_limit: Associated revenue is not automatically incremental revenue; use randomized control when feasible. Do not equate a first-step submit metric with all-step completion or sale.

mobile: No horizontal overflow or obscured submit
interaction: Accessible inline validation and retained values
data: Verified consent changes and no contact enumeration
No contact PII in analytics, URLs, ordinary logs or localStorage
future_implementation_acceptance.quality: Required native review, focused tests/build/performance and actual browser screenshots only once an implementation is authorized.
